# QR code libraries

- qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT).
  https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
  Browser distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js
- jsQR 1.4.0 by the jsQR contributors (Apache-2.0).
  https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
  Browser distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js

License text is included alongside the source files. The distributions are
hosted with the app; QR generation and camera frame decoding run locally in
the browser. No camera frames are sent to an external QR service.
